title: Operations Start Action Permission Consistency

items.action: start generic operations from the Operations page
start a Bulk Email operation from the Operations page

backend.reason: Existing StartOperationUseCase authorization already selects the canonical business permission by operation type.

api.reason: No server API contract changes; only the Operations-page Bulk Email Start boundary is aligned with existing authorization.

audit.reason: Existing operation-start audit behavior is unchanged.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: The /operations route still requires its existing read access; this change only gates the start mutation action.

notes: OperationsPage Bulk Email Start uses fair_crm.fair_emails.execute, matching StartOperationUseCase. Generic Start continues to use fair_crm.operations.execute. Enrichment and Scraper list Start alignment are intentionally outside this focused change. Cancel remains unchanged and is governed separately by fair_crm.operations.execute.
